articles.title: Meta is developing a prediction market app called ‘Arena’ as sector booms: NYT
articles.snippet: The app would let users forecast future events using a points-based system rather than cash wagers, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: In Clarity Act's final weeks, its path through U.S. Senate not getting much clearer
articles.snippet: Tough negotiations linger in several difficult arenas, but crypto's Washington lobbyists are flying in allies this week and still hoping for a July vote.

articles.title: Ripple targets EU, wins preliminary MiCA approval from Luxembourg financial regulator
articles.snippet: The license will enable Ripple to offer its stablecoin payment systems to European companies and expand into broader crypto functions.

articles.title: U.S. Senate passes housing bill that carries four-year ban on a Fed CBDC
articles.snippet: The idea of a U.S. central bank digital currency — though little more than a research topic at the Federal Reserve — may be getting formally blocked.

articles.title: Chainlink joins European and Korean bank consortia to develop FX settlement network
articles.snippet: Banks across Europe and South Korea will study whether regulated euro and won stablecoins can enable real-time cross-border foreign exchange settlement.
